Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-tenta-kaibori/

Join us for shell digging at a restored pond in the foothills of Tenranzan. This satoyama (rural mountain woodland) was acquired by local citizens through a National Trust movement and is now protected as a biotope.

【Fee】Adults and children ¥3,000, preschoolers ¥1,000 (family discounts available from the second child onwards; includes guide, dispatch, pizza ingredients, etc.)

【Capacity】15 people

【Guide】Staff from NPO Tenranzan & Takomineyama Nature Conservation Association

【What to bring】Drinking water, personal cup, chopsticks, towel, change of clothes, mask, hat, rubber boots
location: 集合 飯能市立博物館ロビー（国際興業バス「OH!!!・天覧山下」または「市民会館・博物館」下車徒歩3分）
